Requests for manufacturing and QC information on the unit, its lot and its supplier go through the GC.","apparent_reach":"client","note":"Client practice of routing all employee contact and fact gathering through the GC's office."},{"output_quote":"Because exposure is affected, copy risk management and, through them, the insurer.","apparent_reach":"client","note":"Client reporting practice of notifying the insurer through risk management."},{"output_quote":"Our working hypothesis is that the lockout pin or float valve did not engage at about 10 psi, so the lid could rotate.","apparent_reach":"matter","note":"Matter-specific failure hypothesis with a technical figure."},{"output_quote":"Send the GC the proposed experts' names, credentials, prior testimony and fee quotes, and get clearance before signing anyone.","apparent_reach":"client","note":"Client requirement for GC clearance before retaining an expert."},{"output_quote":"Get a quote and a phase budget before any testing, and seek approval before exceeding budget.","apparent_reach":"client","note":"Client budget-control practice for expert testing."},{"output_quote":"Staffing is at most two lawyers per deposition or hearing (one partner and one associate).","apparent_reach":"client","note":"Specific client staffing limit for depositions and hearings."},{"output_quote":"Throughout, no press or retail contact, and any outside inquiries go to the GC.","apparent_reach":"client","note":"Client instruction restricting press and retail contact."},{"output_quote":"If the client prefers mediation before expert work, we bring opposing counsel along by offering early production of key documents and fixed expert dates, with a trigger if mediation fails.","apparent_reach":"firm","note":"Negotiating tactic for securing mediation before expert work; states no client policy, so it is not a hit for R03."}]}
